purpose.title: About Figurio
points: Figurio is a web-based image editor designed for preparing images for academic and technical documents.
It is intended for students, researchers, and authors who need to quickly refine screenshots, diagrams, and figures without using complex graphic software.
The editor provides essential tools for cropping, highlighting important areas, removing unwanted elements, adding annotations, and applying presentation frames.
Its focused feature set avoids unnecessary complexity while keeping the workflow fast, clear, and intuitive.
Figurio runs directly in the browser with no installation required.
All image processing is performed locally in the browser, emphasizing privacy, security, and protection of sensitive data.

technicalLimitations.title: Technical Limitations
limitations: Pdf files with complex structures may not render perfectly.
Very large image files may result in slower performance depending on your device capabilities.
Animated images (e.g., GIFs) are not supported.
Browser refresh will erase unsaved progress.
